description: This file defines a React component for a documentation or configuration UI page related to MCP (Model Context Protocol) tool integrations. It provides various sections with examples and instructions for setting up integrations with LiteLLM Proxy, OpenAI, Cursor IDE, and Streamable HTTP transport, including code snippets, headers configurations, and user guidance.

classes.name: CodeBlockProps
classes.description: Props interface for the CodeBlock component, including code, title, copyKey, and optional className.

classes.name: FeatureCardProps
classes.description: Props interface for the FeatureCard component, including icon, title, description, children, serverName, and accessGroups.

classes.name: MCPConnectProps
classes.description: Props interface for MCPConnect component, including optional currentServerAccessGroups.

methods.name: FeatureCard
methods.description: A React functional component rendering a card with a feature icon, description, and optional header toggling. It manages headers configuration based on serverName and accessGroups and clones children code snippets to inject headers.

methods.name: CodeBlock
methods.description: A React component displaying a code snippet with a copy button, supports title and styling.

methods.name: StepCard
methods.description: A React component for displaying setup steps with a numbered indicator and content.

methods.name: LiteLLMProxyTab
methods.description: Component rendering content for the LiteLLM Proxy API integration, including setup instructions and code snippets.

methods.name: OpenAITab
methods.description: Component rendering content for OpenAI API integration, including setup instructions and code snippets.

methods.name: CursorTab
methods.description: Component rendering Cursor IDE integration instructions and configuration snippets.

methods.name: StreamableHTTPTab
methods.description: Component providing info and configuration for Streamable HTTP transport method.

methods.name: MCPConnect
methods.description: Main React functional component that composes the UI for MCP tool connections, tabs, and instructions.
